###6.4

```{r, error=TRUE}

#Step 1: calculate the observed F statistic

model_obs <- lm_robust(
  Contact ~ Age + Party + Vote96,
  data = data
)

F_obs <- model_obs$fstatistic[1]

# The F stat would describe how strongly the three pretreatment covariates jointly predict the treatment assignment that actually occured

# Need to compare it to the distribution of F statistics generated by randomization.

# Step 2: delcare the randomization procedure (the procedure for assigning N and m needs to produce the same N and m as that which was actually used)

ra <- declare_ra(
  N = nrow(data), # total num observations
  m = sum(data$Contact == 1) # num assigned to treatment
)

# Step 3: Initialize a vector that will eventualyl hold F stats

B <- 1000 # number of simulated random draws reducing so I can knit (running at 10k)
F_sim <- numeric(B) 

# Step 4: Conduct RI (only the assignment vector changes across iterations)

for (i in 1:B) {

  data$Z_sim <- conduct_ra(ra)

  model_sim <- lm_robust(
    Z_sim ~ Age + Party + Vote96,
    data = data
  )

  F_sim[i] <- model_sim$fstatistic[1]
}

# Step 5: p value

p_value <- mean(F_sim >= F_obs)

# interpretation: under the specified RA procedure, approx (p_value)% of hypothetical assignments produced n F stat at least as large as the observed F stat

#
```

### Question 5


### 5 a
Yes -- This might change the assignments that can occur. I'd need to change how I estimate the CACE because this would require using inverse probability weights. 

### 5 b

```{rr, error=TRUE}
library(broom)


restricted_ra <- function(data, m) {

  while (TRUE) {

    # Generate hypothetical treatment assignment
    Z_temp <- complete_ra(N = nrow(data), m = m)

    # Regress hypothetical assignment on covariates
    model <- lm_robust(
      Z_temp ~ Age + Party + Vote96,
      data = data
    )

    # Extract F-statistic and degrees of freedom
    f <- model$fstatistic

    # Calculate upper-tail F-test p-value
    p_balance <- pf(
      q = f[1],
      df1 = f[2],
      df2 = f[3],
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )

    # ACCEPT assignment only if p > 0.10
    if (p_balance > 0.10) {
      return(Z_temp)
    }
  }
}

# STEP 2: Generate 1k acceptable assignments

set.seed(6081709)

B <- 1000
m <- sum(data$Contact == 1)

sim_matrix <- replicate(
  B,
  restricted_ra(data = data, m = m)
)

# Each  is one acceptable assignment vector
dim(sim_matrix)

# STEP 3: declare

ra_restricted <- declare_ra(
  permutation_matrix = sim_matrix
)

print(ra_restricted)

# STEP 4: Get inverse-probability weights
# Using the OBSERVED assignment Z

data$weights <- 1 /
  obtain_condition_probabilities(
    ra_restricted,
    data$Contact
  )

# STEP 5: Estimate weighted CACE with IV regression

model_cace <- iv_robust(
  Vote98 ~ Contacted | Contact,
  weights = weights,
  data = data
)

# Estimate SE, p-value, CI
print(tidy(model_cace))


```
